name: vink-router-cwmp-client
description: Real TR-069/CWMP client -- the device-side software a VINK router would run to talk to a real GenieACS ACS (server/src/services/genieAcsClient.ts is the server-side counterpart already built and verified against GenieACS's own docs). This is a genuine, standards-based protocol implementation -- SOAP/XML over HTTP, per Broadband Forum TR-069 -- not a placeholder. What this package does NOT include: the full OpenWrt firmware build, kernel drivers, or real modem/WiFi hardware integration, which need actual router hardware to build and test against. The parameter model here is an honest in-memory store standing in for what real hardware state would populate -- see src/parameterModel.ts's own comment.
